minutes_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

September 26, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

Absent:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: September 12, 2023

MOTION:
  • Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve all consent items.
  • The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Abstained:  Ng

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  31 South Primrose Avenue

  •  This is an application for site improvements for the front yard of an existing 1-story
  single family residence which includes a wrought iron fence with a 1-foot step back
  from the property line.

  1
   •  Applicant: Casey Ngo
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Casey Ngo was present. Board Member Daninger asked
  about the proposed color of the fence, if the color is going to be black or white to
  match the existing iron work on the front porch and stair. The applicant responded
  by stating that the fence is proposed black but is ok painting it white as needed.
  Hernandez asked if the ornamental iron work in between the iron tubes is being
  proposed or note. Staff responded that the images are provided as an example.
  Hernandez asked for clarification on dimensions of the bottom iron tube with
  respect to grade level.

MOTION:

  •  Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following conditions: 1)
  The applicant shall provide the height dimensions for the bottom and middle
  wrought iron tube with respect to the grade / ground level; and 2) The applicant
  must re-submit a revised set for City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Vice Chairman Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 3:  3120 Sherwood Avenue

  •  This is an application for nine (9) window replacements on an existing 1-story
  single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Martin Sandoval
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Martin Sandoval was present. Board Member Daninger
  asked if the images provided are existing or proposed windows. The applicant
  responded by stating that the images are existing and the fire department is
  requesting updates due to the remodel of the home caused by a house fire.
  Hernandez stated the window updates are required because the house is being
  remodeled. Hernandez asked the applicant if the window trim plans to be
  refurbished and re-painted to match existing. The applicant agreed.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions: 1) For operable windows at sleeping rooms, the applicant
  must provide existing and proposed net size of opening when window is in the fully
  open position (width x height, in inches) to ensure building and fire code
  requirements are being met; and 2) The applicant must re-submit a revised set for
  City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng

  2
   Noes:  None

ITEM 4:  441 West Main Street

  •  This is an application for one (1) new commercial sign on existing backer panel on
  an existing 1-story commercial building for one tenant.
  •  Applicant: John Estrada
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant John Estrada was present. Board Member Ng asked what
  the proposed color is for the backer panel. The applicant responded that the backer
  panel will be painted to match the color shown in the drawings.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Ng makes a motion to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 5:  2576 Loma Vista Drive

  •  This is an application for new construction of a 2,167 square foot 2-story single-
  family residence with an attached 2-car garage and a new front porch.
  •  Applicant: Jasmine Fang
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Jasmine Fang was present. Board Member Daninger asked
  if the project has been brought to the Design Review Board previously. Staff
  responded yes. Board Member Ng highlighted that there is no exterior lighting
  shown on the plans or on the material board. Tsai agreed and noted that the roof
  form is shown incorrectly in elevation. Tsai also added that the second floor
  window configuration and proportions are not well-balanced. Ng noted that the
  shutter color is too dark and asked if the color is coordinated with other elements
  on the house. The applicant responded that the shutter color is dark grey to match
  the proposed window frame. Ng noted that the drawings do not show any handrails
  for the front entry stairs and asked if this is required. Staff responded that the
  handrails were not brought to the planner’s attention but may be required by the
  building department.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant must show location of exterior lighting on the drawings
  set, either in plan or in elevation with a callout, and provide product details or
  specifications; 2) The applicant shall work with City Staff to re-design the second-
  floor window configuration on the north elevation; 3) Revise the roof line and height

  3
   to accurately depict the roof form in elevation view; 4) Identify the proposed window
  framing and shutter color, which shall be color coordinated; 5) The applicant shall
  work with City Staff on selecting an appropriate stair railing for the front porch as it
  relates to the Spanish architectural style; 6) The applicant must re-submit a revised
  set for City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 6:  1146 South Meridian Avenue

  •  This is an application for new construction of a 155,140 square foot 4-story self-
  storage facility including a lobby, leasing office, storage units, restrooms, 8 loading
  spaces, and 17 parking spaces on site.
  •  Applicant: Kara Tobin, PAL Alhambra Storage, LLC
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Kara Tobin and Architect Scott Jones were present. Board
  Member Hernandez asked the applicant if they understood the conditions provided
  by Staff. The applicant answered yes and changes will be made prior to building
  permit. Board Member Ng asked the selection of the red colored doors shown in
  the drawings. The applicant answered the color of the doors are subject to change
  based on the future company occupying the proposed building space. Board
  Member Tsai noted that the high walls along South Meridian Avenue are currently
  2-dimensional and need a parapet return to give it a more 3-dimensional shape.
  Tsai notes that the metal panel material is awkwardly placed as a cap to the stucco
  wall located in the center of the West façade. The applicant responds that the
  material is used as a transitional element. Staff recommends that the plaster be
  extended to the top of parapet and add additional horizontal reveals along the
  plaster portion of the wall to enhance the horizontal language. Hernandez agrees.
  Tsai agrees and asks that the reveals or horizontal details line up to the top of
  finish floor of 3rd and 4th level. Hernandez added that color may still be introduced
  to the horizontal design scheme.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall provide details for canopy attachment and
  dimensions for canopy width, depth and height with respect to the ground level; 2)
  Provide typical dimensions for the proposed metal panel component. Dimensions
  may be shown in elevation, separate detail, or supplemental product/specification
  document; 3) The applicant shall note the depth for modulations, setbacks,
  transitional elements, and revels on the exterior façade. Dimensions can be shown
  in floor plan or keynote callout in elevation; 4) The applicant shall provide a parapet
  return on the higher walls to give the appearance of building mass, rather than a
  flat wall plane, as seen from the public right-of-way; 5) The applicant shall work
  with City Staff on revising the horizontal elements along the West façade facing
  South Meridian Avenue. Additional horizontal reveals shall be provided and

  4
   coordinated with the 3rd and 4th floor levels; and 6) The applicant must re-submit
  a revised set for City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on September 26, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 9:00 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
